app_pickup_5000_chunked.note: a coin picked up, 50 groups of 100: the update and the view after it. Target: under 2.5 ms.

app_pickup_5000_one_group.note: reference, not a target: one group of 5000 re-describes whole. The guide says chunk instead.

app_walk_20000_camera.note: walking past 20000 coins in 200 groups through a 1280x720 camera following the hero (~2300 on screen). Target: under 2 ms; the check of every entity against the view is the next lever (a spatial grid).

app_walk_5000_grouped.note: a frame of walking past 5000 coins in groups: tick and view. Target: a world's share of a 16.6 ms frame stays under 2 ms.

app_walk_5000_plain.note: reference, not a target: the same 5000 coins without groups, described every view.

frame_encode_20000.note: 20000 sprite instances encoded into a vello scene: the CPU half of painting.

frame_encode_5000.note: 5000 sprite instances encoded into a vello scene.

signal_update_5000.note: an update of a 5000-item signal: nearly all of it the freeze checking every entry.

world_frame_20000.note: the same for 20000, every entity drawn. Was refused by the 4096-item cap.

world_frame_20000_camera.note: the same 20000 through a 1280x720 camera: ~6% drawn. Most of it is checking every entity against the view; a spatial grid would cut that.

world_frame_5000.note: building the frame of a 5000-entity world, every entity drawn (the box is the whole map). Includes each entity's view check.

world_inspect_5000.note: the dump's world inspection of 5000 entities.

world_reconcile_fresh_5000.note: diffing 5000 specs described afresh (built outside the timing).

world_reconcile_kept_5000.note: 5000 entities in a kept group described again: what groups save.

world_steps_5000.note: a 60 fps frame of steps (two) for 5000 things, 200 balls bouncing among 800 rocks.
